card.profile: The Boston refers to various step dances, considered a slow Americanized version of the waltz presumably named after where it originated. It is completed in one measure with the weight kept on the same foot through two successive beats. The "original" Boston is also known as the New York Boston or Boston Point. Variations of the Boston include: The Long Boston also known as the Philadelphia Boston, the Walking Boston or the One Step Waltz. The One-Step. The Short Boston,.
